package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("🎉 欢迎使用 CodeForge!")
	fmt.Println("Welcome to CodeForge!")
	fmt.Println()

	fmt.Println("=========================================")
	fmt.Println("            CodeForge Go               ")
	fmt.Println("=========================================")
	fmt.Println()

	// 基本输出示例
	fmt.Println("✅ Go 运行成功! (Go is working!)")
	fmt.Printf("🔷 Go 版本 (Version): %s\n", runtime.Version())
	fmt.Println()

	// 简单计算
	number1 := 10
	number2 := 20
	result := number1 + number2

	fmt.Println("🔢 简单计算 (Simple calculation):")
	fmt.Printf("%d + %d = %d\n", number1, number2, result)
	fmt.Println()

	// 字符串操作
	name := "CodeForge"
	language := "Go"

	fmt.Println("📝 字符串操作 (String operations):")
	fmt.Println("平台名称 (Platform):", name)
	fmt.Println("编程语言 (Language):", language)
	fmt.Printf("完整信息 (Full info): %s - %s\n", name, language)
	fmt.Println()

	// 循环示例
	fmt.Println("🔄 循环输出 (Loop output):")
	for i := 1; i <= 5; i++ {
		fmt.Printf("第 %d 次输出 (Output #%d): Hello from CodeForge!\n", i, i)
	}

	fmt.Println()

	// 切片操作
	fruits := []string{"苹果", "香蕉", "橙子", "葡萄"}
	fmt.Println("🍎 水果列表 (Fruit list):")
	for index, fruit := range fruits {
		fmt.Printf("%d. %s\n", index+1, fruit)
	}

	fmt.Println()

	// 条件判断
	score := 85
	fmt.Println("📊 成绩评估 (Score evaluation):")
	switch {
	case score >= 90:
		fmt.Println("优秀! (Excellent!)")
	case score >= 80:
		fmt.Println("良好! (Good!)")
	case score >= 60:
		fmt.Println("及格 (Pass)")
	default:
		fmt.Println("需要努力 (Need improvement)")
	}

	fmt.Println()

	// Go 特性展示
	fmt.Println("🆕 Go 特性 (Go features):")
	
	// 结构体
	type Info struct {
		Name     string
		Language string
		Status   string
	}
	
	data := Info{
		Name:     "CodeForge",
		Language: "Go",
		Status:   "运行中",
	}
	fmt.Printf("结构体 (Struct): %+v\n", data)

	// 映射 (Map)
	languages := map[string]string{
		"Go":       "编译型",
		"Python":   "解释型",
		"JavaScript": "解释型",
	}
	fmt.Println("映射 (Map):", languages)

	// 协程示例 (简单展示)
	fmt.Println("⚡ 协程示例 (Goroutine example):")
	done := make(chan bool)
	
	go func() {
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
		fmt.Println("🔥 协程执行完成! (Goroutine completed!)")
		done <- true
	}()
	
	<-done // 等待协程完成

	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Println("🎯 CodeForge Go 代码执行完成!")
	fmt.Println("🎯 CodeForge Go execution completed!")
	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Println("感谢使用 CodeForge 代码执行环境! 🚀")
	fmt.Println("Thank you for using CodeForge! 🚀")
}
